query: How do I make herbed egg wraps?

goal.title: Cook and portion a herb and cheese omelet
goal.description: Turn on the cooktop and crack two eggs into a bowl. Cut sprigs from the countertop herb plants, snip them into the eggs and beat the mixture with a fork. Oil the heated frying pan and pour in the beaten eggs. Unwrap sliced cheese and sprinkle grated cheese over the cooking eggs. Loosen the omelet with a wooden spatula, add cheese strips on one side, fold it and slide it onto the cutting board. Shape the folded omelet, add grated cheese, divide it with the spatula edge and turn off the heat.
goal.final_state: The folded cheese omelet is on the cutting board in separate portions; the spatula rests in the empty pan and the heat is switched off.
procedure: Heat the pan and crack two eggs into the bowl.
Harvest herbs, snip them into the eggs and beat the mixture.
Oil the pan and pour in the beaten eggs.
Prepare and add grated and sliced cheeses as the eggs cook.
Loosen, fold and transfer the omelet to the board.
Shape, garnish and portion the omelet and switch off the heat.

phases.description: Adjust the cooktop, position the bowl, open the carton and crack two eggs into the bowl, leaving the shells on the board.
Take scissors, snip sprigs from the herb plants, cut them over the bowl and beat the egg mixture with a fork.
Pour oil into the pan, put away the bottle and shells, wipe the work area, check the pan and pour in the beaten eggs.
Watch the cooking eggs, move utensils, unwrap a cheese slice, sprinkle grated cheese and loosen the egg edges with the spatula.
Unwrap and tear another cheese slice, lay strips along one side of the cooking egg layer and pick up the spatula.
Work the spatula under the egg edges, lift the pan and fold and slide the omelet onto the cutting board before replacing the pan.
Use fingers and the spatula to shape the folded omelet, sprinkle grated cheese over it, divide and separate portions and turn off the cooktop.
